name: team_planning_set_rule
description: Set one rule in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, by its name from tenants_planning_rules, for the whole plan or, with unit_id, for that unit and the units below it. value is an object in the shape that rule's value_schema gives, and replaces the value above it whole. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit it unless they change it. To follow the parent again, use team_planning_clear_change with facet 'rule:<name>'. A refusal names what is wrong, never the value. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

unit_id.description: Omit to set the rule for the whole plan.
